The dinosaur is depicted in a quadrupedal stance with its head lowered towards the ground. It features the characteristic three horns and a large frill. The skin texture appears smooth and painted rather than biologically detailed, suggesting it is a fiberglass or concrete sculpture rather than a living animal or high-fidelity CGI render.

The left brow horn (viewer's left) seems to have a slight, unnatural curve or warp near the tip that doesn't align perfectly with rigid bone structure, though this could be artistic license.
